settings.emailReadOnly: Your email address is used to sign in; it can't be changed here.
settings.biometricDesc: Ask for your fingerprint or face when opening the app.

language.title: Language
language.syncPending: The app language has changed. It will be saved to your account (notifications and emails) as soon as you're back online.

notif.scope: Pre-alerts and information: these choices apply to notifications shown while the app is open. To turn off notifications received while the app is closed, use your phone settings.
notif.urgenceAlways: Emergencies are always notified, with the highest priority.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: Sample data, no server. Resetting restores the demo children, alerts and history.

security.title: Security
security.twofaFooter: At each sign-in, a one-time code is sent to {{phone}} (SMS or WhatsApp), or to your email if it's verified.
security.twofaConfirmEnable: Enter your password to turn on two-step verification.
security.twofaConfirmDisable: Enter your password to turn off two-step verification.
security.twofaEnabled: Two-step verification is on. A confirmation email was sent if email sending is available.
security.passwordFooter: After the change, your other devices are signed out.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
security.offline: You're offline: security settings can't be changed right now.

about.title: About
about.missionBody: SIREN helps parents protect their children: a device worn by the child sends their location and movements, and an analysis engine spots anything outside their usual routine so you are alerted as early as possible.
about.howBody: The app is your control centre: live map, explained alerts, sharing with trusted contacts and emergency response.
about.notASubstitute: SIREN does not replace an adult's vigilance or emergency services. If there is danger, call the police (117).
about.teamBody: SIREN is built by a team organised in three groups: App, Device and Artificial Intelligence.
about.contactFooter: Contact details are in the legal notice.
about.creditsBody: Map backgrounds © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL licence), served by OpenFreeMap. Map rendering by MapLibre. Inter typeface (SIL Open Font Licence).

settings.logoutConfirmBody: You won't receive alerts on this phone until you sign in again.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: Deletes your account and cuts off all access to your children's data.
settings.deleteBody: Your account will be deleted, along with access to your children's data for you and your trusted contacts. This cannot be undone.
settings.emailOptional: Email is optional; your phone is used to sign in and receive codes.

phone.title: Change phone number
phone.body: Your password is required, then a code is sent to the new number. The change only happens once the code is confirmed; the old number is notified.
phone.completeBody: A phone number is now required: it's used to sign in and to receive your security codes. It is confirmed with a code.
